name: Upspring
description:
Upspring turns Meta ad creative into text Claude can reason about. Every ad in our competitive-intelligence corpus has been analyzed into labeled creative dimensions (hook archetype, persona, persuasion mechanism…), verbatim hooks, full creative
  narration, and landing-page context — so Claude can research hundreds of competitor ads, find what's winning in a market, and break down why it works, all without ever processing a video.
  
  Ask Claude things like: "What hooks are winning in skincare right now?" · "Break down Tatcha's creative strategy" · "Compare our watchlist brands' approaches" · "Find ads similar to this one and tell me what they share."
  
  Connect your Upspring workspace and Claude also sees your own advertising: real performance for your connected ad accounts (spend, ROAS, CPA), your top creatives, your creative patterns, and your brand profile — so "how do we compare to the market?" is answerable in one conversation.
  
 Requires an Upspring account (upspring.ai). Competitive-corpus tools work for every workspace; own-ads tools activate when your ad accounts are connected in Upspring.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Upspring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Upspring to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.upspring.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Upspring MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upspring lists 19 MCP tools, including compare_advertisers, find_similar_ads, get_ad_descriptors, get_ad_media, get_advertiser_brief, get_my_ads_performance, get_my_brand_profile, get_my_creative_patterns, get_my_performance_summary, get_my_top_ads, get_onboard_status, and get_taxonomy.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Upspring?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Upspring in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Upspring requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Upspring is developed by Upspring.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
